summary: The PR addresses the issue of making RenameModel a no-op when db_table is unchanged, but there are some concerns about test coverage and documentation.

issues.description: The PR does not include any additional tests to verify that RenameModel is indeed a no-op when db_table is unchanged. This is important to ensure the fix works as intended.
The PR lacks a docstring or comment explaining why the change is made, which could help future maintainers understand the reasoning behind the code.
